title: REQ · SceneObject renders bounds, hover highlight, name label and emits click
summary: SceneObject wires pointer interaction through RenderContext
description: Context: RenderHandle only has setVisible and destroy. Desired behavior: createSprite receives the object name and interaction bounds; the handle exposes setHighlighted, setLabelVisible, onHover and onClick. SceneObject toggles highlight and label on hover and emits an interact event on click, only when visible. Expected result: pointer interaction is data-driven with no Phaser in the entity. Why: hover and click identify and trigger interactive objects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a spec with a name and bounds, When constructed, Then createSprite receives label equal to spec.name and the computed bounds
Given hover enters then leaves, When callbacks fire, Then setHighlighted and setLabelVisible receive true then false
Given a visible object is clicked, When onClick fires, Then the interact listener receives the object id and availableActions for the state
Given the object is hidden by visibleWhen, When clicked or hovered, Then no event is emitted and no highlight shows
technical_constraints: Reuse availableActions and pointInBounds from systems/interaction.ts
